implementation_boundaries: participant authority never pools through host or space identity
invitation acceptance is online and revalidates recipient binding/current space/version/join authority
visibility filtering precedes participant counts and contribution projection
contributions are attributable owner-domain operation references requiring fresh authorization and expected versions
resource truth remains A8/shared-assets owner authority
partial reservation acquisition unwinds only before commit begins; ambiguous owner commit keeps reservations/evidence and requires recovery rather than blind retry
host cannot consent/spend/choose for another participant
leave/revoke removes future authority without erasing committed history; rejoin requires fresh authorization and revoked membership cannot silently restore access
no public matchmaking, multiplayer AutoGM, broad offline authoritative shared play or AI mechanical/canonical/consent authority
completion_gate: PASS — invited known participants can join safely, see only authorized participants/contributions, contribute independently through fresh authorization, avoid double-spend, recover ambiguous commits without blind retry, leave/revoke/rejoin safely and use the core shared workspace without AI.
